BiblicalUsage: The word appears once, in Daniel's picture of the kingdoms: the iron and the clay do not stick to one another, and the divided kingdom cannot hold. A mixture that will not cleave is the image of a world that cannot be joined.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the verse pictures every human empire: strong in part and brittle in part, and unable to hold together.
